description: This file contains ARM assembly code for BoringSSL's implementation of AES encryption/decryption, key schedule, and related transformations, specifically optimized for ARMv7 architecture with NEON support. It includes constants, key setup functions, encryption/decryption cores, and routines for converting keys to BSAES format.

methods.name: vpaes_preheat
methods.description: Initializes constants and tables used in AES operations.

methods.name: vpaes_encrypt_core
methods.description: Performs AES encryption on a block using precomputed keys.

methods.name: vpaes_decrypt_core
methods.description: Performs AES decryption on a block using precomputed keys.

methods.name: vpaes_schedule_core
methods.description: Generates round keys for AES based on key size.

methods.name: vpaes_schedule_transform
methods.description: Applies linear transformation to AES keys.

methods.name: vpaes_schedule_mangle
methods.description: Transforms keys between different basis representations.

methods.name: vpaes_encrypt_key_to_bsaes
methods.description: Converts VPAES key to BSAES format.

methods.name: vpaes_decrypt_key_to_bsaes
methods.description: Converts BSAES key to VPAES format.

methods.name: vpaes_ctr32_encrypt_blocks
methods.description: Encrypts multiple blocks in CTR mode.
